shared_elements: registers/rows of figures on a flat surface
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures and (in A) animals, but the only overlap is at the most generic level: A shows a naturalistic bearded man in profile with a bridled horse rendered with modelled musculature and detailed hair and harness, while B shows tiny stick-like human figures, many crewed boats with upcurved prows and rows of crew strokes, and a long line of cupmarks, all in flat schematic silhouette. There is no shared motif, no shared relationship between elements, and the conventions of depiction (modelled relief naturalism versus reductive stick-figure schematism) are opposite.
